subject.title: marketplace-crons: Fnac devuelve 400 al marcar pedidos como enviados

question: Is the related no-recurrence evidence from https://github.com/Hamelyn-SL/hamelyn-serverless/issues/5492 enough to close this shipment-400 issue, or should this issue stay open until the current order/panel state is checked directly?
rationale: The code path is still present and this issue has confirmed-live labeling, but the latest same-signature discussion says the June production burst self-resolved, so only a maintainer with current production access can decide whether cleanup is safe.

options.title: Verify live recurrence first
options.body: Check current BigQuery for `FNAC API SET ORDERS AS SHIPPED` 400s and the affected Fnac order state, then either close as self-resolved or keep this as the active canonical.

options.title: Close as transient provider state
options.body: If current production has no recent occurrences and the orders are no longer actionable, close this issue as the same self-limiting mechanism documented in the older closed report.

options.title: Authorize a diagnostic fix
options.body: If failures still recur, sponsor a narrow PR that logs sanitized Fnac response details per order and adds reconciliation only for confirmed rejected states.

recommendation.title: Verify live recurrence first
recommendation.body: Check current BigQuery for `FNAC API SET ORDERS AS SHIPPED` 400s and the affected Fnac order state, then either close as self-resolved or keep this as the active canonical.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent code-history signal on the shared shipping/recovery path and applied the confirmed-live marketplace-orders labels.
